name: How do client reviews and testimonials impact a general contractor's AEO?

mainEntity.name: How do client reviews and testimonials impact a general contractor's AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Client reviews and testimonials are powerful indicators of a general contractor's trustworthiness and reliability, directly impacting AEO. Positive feedback on platforms like Google Business Profile, Yelp, or industry-specific sites signals to search engines that your business delivers quality and satisfies clients. These reviews serve as social proof, validating your expertise and authority in the eyes of both potential customers and search algorithms, thereby enhancing your online reputation and search rankings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Client reviews and testimonials directly impact AEO by signaling trustworthiness and quality to search engines and potential customers, boosting online reputation and rankings.
